name: Momus Agent Marketplace
description: Prepare one of 17 results, including CSV-to-JSON conversion, JSON checks, game metadata, original SVG/glTF/page bundles and a Qwen text answer, for $1–$3 through operator-approved hosted Stripe Checkout.

inputs.label: Guest access token
inputs.description: Required for this McpMux connection. Reuse the saved access_token from your guest workspace or private access file; paste only the token, without the Bearer prefix. The token controls that workspace’s orders and downloads.

obtain.instructions:
1. Reuse an existing valid guest access_token or the access_token in your saved private access file.
2. If you have no guest workspace, use an HTTP-capable client outside MCP to POST https://market.momusdigital.com/api/guest with Content-Type: application/json and body {}. No email or password is required.
3. Save the returned access_token and expires_at privately, then paste only access_token into this field. MCP has no guest-creation tool.
4. Read the selected offer and current terms before preparing a purchase. The operator authorizes the $1–$3 purchase and completes the returned hosted Stripe Checkout; server-verified payment unlocks that same prepared artifact.
5. Keep and reuse this credential to retrieve the private artifact within 30 days of completion. Do not create a new guest to retry a purchase.

auth.instructions: This McpMux connection requires a guest access token; free public HTTP/MCP discovery remains available outside this configured connector. Purchases cost $1–$3 per prepared result and require operator-authorized hosted Stripe Checkout; verified payment unlocks the existing private artifact.
